notes.title: Vietnamese language update
notes.content:
Dear users,

There was a mistake in the release of the Vietnamese language, making it unavailable to users.
This is now correctly fixed.

Sorry for the disagreement.

notes.title: Hatsune Miku VR update, new DLC, sale and huge giveaway!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32526477/b7058c944b684b73813de1139bf92ee9ae9a650e.png

First up, Hatsune Miku VR just got an update and new DLC bringing the total songs up to 19!

Update
Stage Select Screen
Added a costume and stick select (new Snow Miku & Negi available)
Music Video mode
New song select screen: choose 8 songs to watch as a playlist with new costume select, stick select and stage select too.
Sound enhancements
Rebalanced volume levels and changed in-game music to 3D sound.
New free song
STELLA (by KotsubaneP)
New free stage
Snow stage


Sale
And if that wasn't enough, we also have a sale on!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/707300/

Contest
And to celebrate the update, DLC and launching on the Oculus store, we have a contest running on Gleam with prizes which include official Miku goodies, tickets to the Hatsune Miku Expo in Hong Kong in July and more!
Check the link below to enter:
https://gleam.io/bJt0s/hatsune-miku-vr-oculus-rift-experiences-launch

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Update to Chinese Simplified translation
notes.content:
The Chinese Simplified translation has now been updated.
Thanks for you reports.

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Update - Steam overlay support
notes.content:
We're happy to let you know that Symphonic Rain was now updated to support Steam Overlay correctly.

Enjoy taking screenshots of Chris and his friends with one stroke of F12 !

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Language and Graphic Fix
notes.content:
Language and graphic fix patch is available today.
Fixed some localization errors on English, Japanese and Chinese
Fixed some graphic bugs
Thank you for enjoying Symphonic Rain!

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Message from Mai Nakahara
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Symphonic Rain!
A celebratory comment from Mai Nakahara, who plays Tortinita/Arietta, is now live on the official website.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28754622/ea9277077fe394ccbf74d9740071cb650eff35a7.png

http://www.kogado.com/sw/contents/kuroneko/sr2017/en/

Please enjoy the comments, including her memories of that time along with a few words from scenario writer Maoto Nishikawa.

notes.title: Symphonic Rain will be at Anime Expo 2017
notes.content:
Degica Games is Bringing You the Best Games from Japan to Anime Expo
We’ll be showcasing some of our most popular titles, along with a few surprises, so make sure to stop by our booth to experience them firsthand! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25296213/aa6b091a8e88bc6996615c60391cdbbc58d2cd72.png

Location: LA Convention Center - Booth # 4130
Date: July 1st - July 4th
http://www.anime-expo.org/

MERCH & GIVEAWAYS!!!
Visit our booth and get free original fans, game stickers, postcards and other swag! We’ll also have an exclusive Symphonic Rain Steam key card available at 20% off and first 50 people can get limited button set!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28754622/495573b50113c88e125d009c30144848d6d2ab72.png
We’ll also be holding a raffle with cool prizes for anyone who spends over $10 at our store.

Make sure to stop by booth # 4130 to meet the Degica crew and play some awesome games! Hope to see you there. :)

notes.title: Symphonic Rain: Patch 20170619
notes.content:
Here are a few more fixes for you favorite musical visual novel:

    Fix for "p" and "q" cropped off in song lyrics
    Key wrongly show as "+" in the music minigame has been corrected to ":"
    Fix for the problem that could happen when 2 characters were on sceen simultaneously
Fix to the English and Chinese translation
